reference_sql:
WITH daily AS (
  -- one row per UTC day with signups
  SELECT CAST(signup_ts AS DATE) AS signup_date, COUNT(*) AS signups
  FROM signups
  GROUP BY CAST(signup_ts AS DATE)
), windowed AS (
  -- one row per UTC day with signups
  SELECT signup_date, signups,
    SUM(signups) OVER (ORDER BY signup_date RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL 6 DAY PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) / 7.0 AS avg_7d
  FROM daily
)
SELECT signup_date, signups, ROUND(avg_7d, 2) AS avg_signups_7d
FROM windowed
WHERE signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'

  SELECT CAST(signup_ts AS DATE) AS signup_date, COUNT(*) AS signups

)
SELECT d.signup_date, d.signups, ROUND(SUM(p.signups) / 7.0, 2) AS avg_signups_7d

WHERE d.signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'

solver.query:
WITH days AS (SELECT CAST(g AS DATE) AS signup_date FROM generate_series(DATE '2025-06-25', DATE '2025-10-31', INTERVAL 1 DAY) t(g)),
s AS (
  SELECT CAST(CAST(signup_ts AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS DATE) AS d, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM signups GROUP BY 1
),
x AS (
  SELECT days.signup_date, COALESCE(s.n, 0) AS signups FROM days LEFT JOIN s ON s.d = days.signup_date
),
y AS (
  SELECT signup_date, signups, SUM(signups) OVER (ORDER BY signup_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS s7 FROM x
)
SELECT signup_date, signups, ROUND(s7 / 7.0, 2) AS avg_signups_7d
FROM y WHERE signup_date >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND signups > 0
